contract.end_state: Zero unexplained failures of the nightly backup job over 14 consecutive scheduled runs.

proof.primary: 14/14 consecutive scheduled runs complete with matching manifests
proof.integrity: one run observed under concurrent snapshot load without recurrence
proof.provenance: reviewed commit on the canonical backup repo; window read from the scheduler log

contract.stop_rule: Complete only when all runs and the integrity check are satisfied. The user may interrupt, redirect, pause, or cancel at any time.

goal_control.authorized_priority: restorable backups that protect the data
goal_control.proxy_failure: runs go green because the job narrows what it backs up
goal_control.acceptable_cost: retry logic may change; the backup target may not

contract.end_state: The checkout error-rate dashboard returns to its pre-incident level.

proof.primary: the dashboard error rate stays at the pre-incident level for a week
proof.integrity: the dashboard is checked twice daily
proof.provenance: screenshots of the dashboard are archived

contract.stop_rule: Complete when the dashboard holds at the pre-incident level for a week.

contract.end_state: No dead links remain in the published docs; the checker runs in CI.

proof.primary: the link checker reports zero broken links
proof.integrity: a seeded known-dead link is caught by the CI job
proof.provenance: the checker runs against the deployed docs site

contract.stop_rule: Complete only when the zero-broken report and the seeded check hold. The user may interrupt, redirect, pause, or cancel at any time.

goal_control.proxy_failure: zero broken links because dead links were deleted with their sentences
goal_control.acceptable_cost: links may change; page content may not
